introHtml: Azaleeinnovation lanyards offer a reliable nylon webbing construction that holds up to daily wear in office, school, or event settings. With options like the 3/4" Nylon Web Lanyard and the Super Value Lanyard, you can choose from over a dozen styles including woven, knit-in, and recycled materials. These lanyards pair well with badge holders and clips for secure ID display. Perfect for HR directors needing consistent employee badges or marketing teams distributing branded credentials at conferences.
